observations.B01: Author number 32; one straight vertical and separate dot give ! after the first hatted M. No corresponding exponent is visible after the second M. Only Cas de is underlined.
observations.B02: Three ruled columns with headings codim 0, 1, 2. Counts over transition arrows are parenthesized 10 and 3. Right chain labels have one prime, three primes, and the compact raised IV respectively; its middle cardinal is 1. Filled vertices and both connecting segments retained.
observations.B03: Opening D-word has very reduced following strokes and remains uncertain between Donc and Dans; the following dans is separate. Raised marks at both M letters have the exclamation shape. Heavy cancellation after the second formula obscures its full content. Diagonal set arguments {0,1,infinity}, I double-prime continue the marginal Isom of B06. Bottom-edge fragments of the longer inserted formula are handled in B04.
observations.B04: Small plus précisément, un precedes a densely canceled formula, whose surviving doubled upright and subscript traces do not support a full reading. Above the baseline is a hatted M with subscript 0,I double-prime(3) disjoint-union (*), isomorphic to the P-one expression. A long joining stroke attaches that insertion. Lower phrase reads tentatively ayant / comme on avait vu, with its letter boundaries uncertain; neighboring line fragments excluded.
observations.B05: Et and the closing parenthesis are clear. The intervening word ends in dotted i and tall t, but its small connecting loops support either avait or aurait. Three points à l’infini and dash les are legible. Top-edge cancellation belongs to B04.
observations.B06: Clockwise 22-degree rotation used to bring diagonal margin writing towards upright. Double-prime I under P-one, def over equality, Z under the second P-one, and subscript 3 on the script S are visible. The last word reads Isom; its arguments continue diagonally in B03.
observations.B07: Abbreviations pts and nb preserved. Numerator 30, denominator 2 and result 15 are separated clearly; top-edge fragments excluded.
observations.B08: Thin connecting strokes read correspondant aux partitions; terminal word de has no visible final s. The label is I(5).
observations.B09: Type is followed by (2,2,1); the second line has correspondent aux parties. Raised I with one prime is connected by an insertion caret before de. Upper-edge descender excluded.
observations.B10: Cardinal 2 and Deux tels diviseurs are clear. The two subset labels have one and two primes; membership sign and subscript 2 under the script P are visible.
observations.B11: The short abbreviation is three s-shaped characters. Elles is crossed by a straight stroke. On a precedes the intersection equation; empty-set mark is a slashed oval. Edge fragments excluded.
observations.B12: I minus the parenthesized union has a separate diagonal subtraction/setminus stroke. The words after it tentatively read forment juste and have heavy continuous horizontal through-strokes, interpreted here as cancellation; this status and the final word are less secure than the surrounding line. Tuple is (2,2,1). Top-edge fragment excluded.
observations.B13: D’après, étude combinatoire, and icosaèdre are readable; the lower-edge cap of I belongs to the next box.
observations.B14: Choisissons followed by une orientation; dash ce qui and the second-line orienté are clear. Ends ou encore un. Fragments above and below excluded.
observations.B15: Abbreviation icos. followed by gauche and a closing parenthesis. The hat and upper strokes of the next-line M at the lower edge are excluded.
observations.B16: Only les 10 diviseurs à is fully inside this box. Initial fragment of the following l at the right edge is continued in B18 and not completed from inference.
observations.B17: Hatted M has subscript 0,I without a visible exclamation. A small 10 lies above a caret between les and the compressed abbreviation for elements; abbreviated letters remain uncertain. Top-edge icos. gauche material is covered by B15.
observations.B18: Top l’infini completes B16. Two heavily crossed words lie immediately beneath; a short following word resembles en, then one unclear cursive word. Lower crossed word resembles corresp. but is uncertain. The overlapping 2(I), at lower left is covered by B17.
observations.B19: Pencil foliation has closed lower loop of 6 and a long upper bar with curved lower stroke of 5; read 65.
